142542.overview:
Paying homage to the classic beat 'em up in the arcades, The Simpsons: Treehouse of Horror stars Homer, Bart, and Krusty as they try to stop an alien invasion from taking over the Earth. The game plays just like the original arcade version, featuring lots of characters and bosses -- including Futurama and Family Guy cameos -- as well as exciting levels, cool weapons, and vehicles to drive!

Includes Bonus Games!
 - Reclaim Burns Manor: Play as Vampire Mr. Burns and stop the criminals from looting your mansion
 - Tournament mode: Face enemies in one-on-one combat
 - Family Guy: You are Peter and see the events that unfold before he and his family are teleported to Springfield

142642.overview:
Short abandoned demo by OzGames. Play as Nobunaga and slash your way through a couple of stages. Notably uses high-resolution sprites from anime fighting games.

Play as Oda Nobunaga, the main antagonist of the Sengoku Basara series. In the anime, Oda Nobunaga serves as the primary antagonist, as he was responsible for occurring the events throughout the story. He often called himself "The Demon King of the Sixth Heaven" and he always says based on his motto: "To take the world by force", though it became clear that he would rule the world with fear and total tyranny of darkness, according to Shingen Takeda.

153818.overview: Sega Brawlers Megamix, named after Sega's first official crossover, Fighters Megamix, is meant to bring together many of Sega's characters into one big brawler game, completely different from what you get from a smash bros game, but I still worked in 2D plain stages like them. It features a roster of 87 playable characters spanning from Sonic, Streets of Rage, Golden Axe, Guardian Heroes, and many other Sega titles, including guests like Earthworm Jim and Battletoads. These guests were added due to being on a Sega console but largely inactive since then, but some of this has changed not, but it wont effect the game's roster. There are several secret characters in the game, they are unlocked simply by beating adventure mode and when choosing one of the previously locked modes from the menu.

163694.overview:
Streets of Rage: Silent Hill, a beat'em up developed by OpenBor, takes the classic Streets of Rage and mixes it with environments and characters from the Silent Hill franchise. You'll be able to play as characters from both Silent Hill 1 and 2 (for example, the villain Pyramid Head).

The gameplay is typical for this genre: you'll walk down the streets of Silent Hill fighting dozens of enemies that will come at you from all angles. Although you'll find objects that heal you, you won't be able to use any weapons.

The detailed graphics in Streets of Rage: Silent Hill are excellent. Some elements are taken straight from other OpenBor games, while others are original and have their own great style. The animations of dead bodies fit perfectly with the game's environment.

Streets of Rage: Silent Hill is a very fun action game that contains enough elements to satisfy both Silent Hill and Streets of Rage fans.

185601.overview:
Super Karate Kid is a fan-made remake of the 1987 game for the NES, developed by Merso X using the OpenBOR engine.

Differences include:

• Updated graphics and sound
• Background and foreground are easier to distinguish from each other
• Updated controls: designated buttons for jumping and special attacks
• Short invincibility period after getting hit, avoids getting sandwiched between two enemies
• New intro and ending sequences
• Features appearance by arch nemesis Johnny Lawrence

197292.overview:
Corruption, religious impiety and the unscrupulous selling of indulgences strengthened the Protestant Reformers who, denouncing the morality of the Roman Catholic Church, founded their own organizations to combat the growing dark forces. Witchcraft and vampire hunting are among the many unorthodox activities strongly condemned and persecuted by the church.

At the beginning of the 17th century, reports emerged from the small Hungarian village of Čachtice regarding the disappearance of several young women, as well as the increasing presence of horrendous nocturnal creatures in the region.

The church dismissed these claims until the victims included the young daughters of aristocrats and landowners close to the Countess Elizabeth Bathory, who owns a large castle in Čachtice. Reports also mentioned the existence of an ancient pagan relic recently acquired by the Countess.

Taking matters into their own hands, the church dispatched two of his paladins to pay a visit to the countess and investigate that mysterious relic...

200195.overview: It's Streets of Rage with zombies! This bloody beat 'em up was created as an OpenBOR project and released in 2017 on ChronoCrash.com. Play as one of six Streets of Rage fighters, including a zombie, and smash your way through hordes of disgustingly awesome mutilated corpses of the undead. With great sprite-based graphics and fast and fluid brawler gameplay, creator suhmai adds a worthy entry into the homebrew OpenBOR database.

209642.overview:
What do you want in a Streets of Rage title? Tight game play? Stiff challenge? All the original playable characters? Streets of Rage 2X takes all of this and adds much more to build a game that's all its own, yet still has the familiar Streets of Rage feel.

Best be ready though, bring anything less than your A game and this offering will spit you out like Bongo's last meal.

    Four player support.
    Block, evade, juggle, and many other new techniques, all blended perfectly into the original move set.
    Unleash the awesome Rage technique to flatten your enemies - but watch out, bosses have their own to use on you!
    Speed running the old games? Improved AI is here to teach you a little humility.
    Ready for an even tougher challenge? Unlock Rebellion Mode and try to fight your way through as any member of the Streets of Rage cast. Finish a game with Galsia to prove you're the true SOR master!
    No one to play with? Grab an AI partner to keep you company.

Note: This project is now upgraded to the newer Streets of Rage X. For the latest, greatest experience, check it out here: https://www.chronocrash.com/forum/resources/streets-of-rage-x-windows-android.274/

210693.overview:
The world of Metro City like you've never seen before.The game was created by Machok through the OpenBoR engine. Here we find the handwriting of some of the best authors.However, the Machok compilation is unique. With its simplicity and lightness, Street Fighter 89 The Final Fight becomes an optimal remake of the highest quality. The units and sets are perfectly synchronized, and the simulation to the original game is perfect.
You will notice that all the elements are coordinated in detail so as to recreate the world of Capcom. What has been added is a wider world. You would say that these are the cut episodes and footage from Final Fight. But on the contrary, these are the missing episodes of the story and are completely original elements added by Machok. With them, the world of Metro City becomes wider, more voluminous, and the story more complete. So we can call the game Street Fighter 89 The Final Fight, an extended edition of Final Fight. Of course, there are many innovations, both in terms of decor and functional elements. Now, for example, the barrels are more difficult to break, there are levels that develop in a single-row martitsa, many elevators and niches where fighters come out. Other ornaments, such as Andore's whiskers, also create an interesting and entertaining atmosphere.
A number of new tunnels, corridors and ramps will create in you the feeling of a new and complete adventure that was once hidden from the fans.


the profile of Haggar: Street Fighter 89 The Final Fight is quite a difficult game and you will need skill to play it. You will have to train a lot. Of course, you can also use the cheats menu that comes with the OpenBoR console. it will make it easier for you by adding additional qualities to the characters. You can count on a total of three players and these are the classic Guy, Cody which is in two versions and Haggar.

216629.overview: This project is to pay tribute to the famous character created the genius of Shigeru Miyamoto, S.E.E.P. He decided to follow his own way by mixing the genre of platform with the Beat Em Up, the result is: Mario Super Brawl.

216708.overview:
Fighting Street Hack Boss is an alternative version of Fighting Street by SEEP. Here you can play as all boss of Street Fighter 1 and have too many exclusive features. This “hack” is created as homage for all Street Fighter fans.t. ;)
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Fighting Street Hack Boss es una versión alternativa de Fighting Street by SEEP . Aquí puedes jugar como todos los jefes de Street Fighter 1 y ademas contienes funciones exclusivas. Este "Bootleg" se crea como homenaje a todos los fans de Street Fighter. ;)

216806.overview:
The Return of Double Dragon is a Open Beats of Rage Mod tribute to the Technos Japan series of beat 'em up games that originated back in 1987. The original Double Dragon games spanned over some classic consoles including the Nintendo Entertainment System (NES), Sega Master System (SMS), Atari 2600, Nintendo Game Boy, Sega Genesis / Mega Drive and Atari Lynx.

This really is a must-have; even for people who never played Double Dragon before. It features the original plot that this game was supposed to have, but sadly got cut into the versions we all know...

- Mr.Q

Source: https://dcevolution.sourceforge.net/index.php?id=return_of_double_dragon

216888.overview:
Street of Rage is a Japanese Beat 'em up video game developed by SEGA and released in 1991 for Sega Genesis, and then episode 2 was released in 1992 and episode 3 in 1994. Felipe Silva takes up the concept and transfers it to the OpenBOR engine to create Street of Rage: Legacy but with great difference, and graphic improvements as well as new techniques...

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Street Of Rage es un videojuego Beat 'em up japonés desarrollado por SEGA y lanzado en 1991 para Sega Genesis y luego fue lanzado el episodio 2 en 1992 y en 1994 el episodio 3. Felipe Silva retoma el concepto y lo traslada al motor OpenBOR para crear Street Of Rage: Legacy pero con grandes diferencia, y mejoras graficas como tambien tecnicas nuevas...

217059.overview:
Fighting Street is a Street Fighter remake, the first part of the famous fighting video game saga created and launched Capcom in 1987. In fact, the name of this miming comes from the conversion of the original game made for the Turbo Grafx CD.

In this case, it is not a fighting game but a beat'em up starring Ryu and Ken who tells the phase of his training with Master Gouken. Then, the game will change between pure beat'em phases against groups of enemies and levels in a single plan with much of the platforms. At certain times you will even have to fight some enemies in the usual style 1 vs. 1.

In fact, the main characters can use some of their classic movements such as Shoryuken or Hadoken. Although Fighting Street is based on the characters and situations of the first game, some characters from other games such as the Fight Final Saga also appears, so although most graphics are adapted from the original game, many of the audiovisual resources have been created right from the start.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Fighting Street es un remake de Street Fighter, la primera parte de la famosa saga de videojuegos de lucha creada y lanzadapor Capcom en 1987. De hecho, el nombre de este fangame proviene de la conversión del juego original hecho para el Turbo Grafx CD.

En este caso, no se trata de un juego de lucha sino de un beat'em up protagonizado por Ryu y Ken que narra la fase de su entrenamiento con maestro Gouken. Entonces, el juego cambiará entre fases de beat'em puro contra grupos de enemigos y niveles en un solo planificar con gran parte de las plataformas. En ciertos momentos incluso tendrás que luchar contra algunos enemigos en el estilo habitual 1 vs 1.

De hecho, los personajes principales podrán utilizar algunos de sus movimientos clásicos como el Shoryuken o el Hadoken. Aunque Fighting Street se basa en los personajes y situaciones del primer juego, algunos personajes de otros juegos como de la saga Final Fight también aparece, así que aunque la mayoría de los gráficos están adaptados del juego original, muchos de los recursos audiovisuales se han creado desde cero.

219613.overview:
Final Fight Gold Super Extra is the latest known version of the Final Fight Gold series by Pierwolf, with additions by Don Drago and FinalFighter. The game combines the best of Street Fighter and Final Fight with a gritty aesthetic and Pierwolf's trademark level up system to create a unique blend of action and strategy. This final version is exclusive to Sega Dreamcast using the DreamBOR engine (OpenBOR for Sega DreamCast) by Ian Micheal.

Version 3.01 [2025-05-31]:
* For one / Two simultaneous players
* 24 chars from both Final Fight 1, 2, 3 and Super Street Fighter 2 Turbo + Extra aviable!
* New Modes & Soundtracks
* custom throws for all chars!
* all chars have 3 Special Moves and one Ultimate Move (see the HOW TO PLAY for the list)!
* 42 classic enemies and bosses!
* 28 BG, divided in 5 stages with multiple paths!
* Six classics bonus stages!
* New auction effect
* Level up (falsified)
* New mechanics in the game
* a classic boss mode, aviable when you beat the game the first time!
* a training mode, where you can train your moves!
* and some twist from the story of the original Final Fight!

422566.overview:
A continuation of the previous SOR2X game, which recreates all the classic Streets of Rage games with an enhanced fighting mechanic, new features plus now including the first game as a totally new route.

Currently in beta state and subject to big updates. Stay tuned!

443113.overview:
In a scenario where the streets of São Paulo have been taken over by chaos, a devastating new drug threatens to consume the city from the inside out. The police find themselves powerless in the face of the growing wave of violence and corruption. Faced with this darkness, a group of unlikely heroes emerges, determined to make a difference and restore peace to the metropolis. These justice warriors are known as Axel, Blaze, Adam, Blood, Hawk and Boomer.
Streets of Vendetta CracolandWar is an action-adventure game with beat 'em up elements, where players can choose between six characters to play alone or in cooperative mode with friends. Each character has unique skills and their own fighting style, allowing multiple strategies and approaches to overcome challenges.

447600.overview: This game is an unofficial sequel to the trilogy and is titled Streets of Rage 4. The future, according to the creators of this game, looks quite bleak. Dark and dilapidated lots. Tired of long battles, our wars are fought here in a post-apocalyptic world. But through the ruins and reddened armor, the battles continue to intensify. Our tired heroes throw their weapons into fierce battles. Max is particularly productive here. Powerful and stable, he is also the best choice for a hero. Other eligible fighters are our well-known Axel, Blaze, Skate and Adam.

453092.overview: Shiva & Lisa: Episode One is a 2-player SOR fangame produced using the OpenBOR engine. It is the first SOR game to focus entirely on characters from the evil Syndicate, namely the titular characters who originally appeared as bosses in SOR2 and SOR3 respectively. The story involves Lisa seeking revenge after Mona (her sister) is killed by Mr. X, with Shiva agreeing to help take down his former master. With an aggressive soundtrack and fast action with the ability to pull off some monster combos using the new "Juggle" gameplay technique, Shiva & Lisa: Episode One is an interesting and entertaining addition to the growing plethora of fan-produced SOR titles available.

453102.overview: This version of Series Z of Streets of Rage, OpenBoR, has its own characteristics. Along with the innovations typical of the games in this series, the ability to enter the buildings along the way and fight there has been added. The linear development has been changed, adding the ability to choose a path to take. The fights are well synchronized, there are new spectacular grips, and the way you use the weapons in the game has changed. You can take a bat and make a good batch of hits with it. The players you can use are: Axel, Blaze, Max, Ralf, Shiva, and Yuri.

453103.overview:
Strider X depicts an original timeline after the defeat of Onslaught in Capcom's Vs. series. Strider
Hiryu must take on an all new threat, but this time he isn't alone. Try out Strider Kain and Strider Syfer for a change of pace. Look hard enough and maybe you'll find more. Engaging story and challenging foes will keep you fighting to see what or who is around the next corner.

453122.overview: Converted from Baritomarchetto's (@barito) original game. Step into Masami Kurumada's popular shōnen jump saga and control your own destiny. Are you ready?

453125.overview: Based on the Sonic the Hedgehog cross-media franchise (consisting of video games, comic books, television shows, and more), the game has a six-button layout based around a set of special moves for each character, each activated with one button. Enemies often come in unrelenting swarms at players, encouraging use of these moves. The game features both two-dimensional and three-dimensional stages, as well as special running stages based on the Mach Speed Sections. The game features a map to select levels. In addition to the 19 Sonic characters (taken not only from games, but comics and TV as well), the game also features a number of special guest heroes unlocked by helping them put in specific levels. A group of four heroes who initially inspired Sonic are amongst them, as are other characters inspired by them and Sonic.

453165.overview: Shiva & Lisa: Episode Two is a SOR fangame that continues the epic story of betrayal and corruption in the evil Syndicate that began in the original Shiva & Lisa. The titular characters are back, and more destructive than ever! This sequel has once again been produced using the popular OpenBOR engine, and there has been a vast number of improvements since the first title. There are now 11 Special Attacks for each character, and an amazing combo system with infinite possibilities to create your own combos! New ground-to-air combos to destroy enemies in the air, and many enemies on screen provides some crazy SOR action! With new stages, new bosses and enemies, more challenging and balanced gameplay, Shiva & Lisa 2 is everything fans of the original hoped it would be, and more!

453166.overview: Ready for some fightin'? @bWWd's take on the colorful Amiga Street Fighter clone is filled to the brim with nonstop four player action, splashy effects, and brutal KOs. Try out some fighters from franchises like Double Dragon and Street Fighter for even more mayhem. What are you waiting for?

453168.overview: Wield the Legendary Sword of Omens in a challenging side scrolling adventure. Watch your back - one false move and Lion-O is one with his ancestors!

453181.overview: Shiva & Lisa: Episode Three is the long-awaited final chapter in the popular Shiva & Lisa fangame trilogy, produced once again by MasterDerico Productions, for Windows and PSP, using the OpenBOR engine (improved significantly since the previous title, Shiva & Lisa: Episode Two.) This time, more characters, dark, awesome music, insane gameplay and epic combos, make for a SOR experience you won't soon forget! The Syndicate criminals are back, and more powerful than ever! It's time to take them to the Streets of Rage once again!

453214.overview:
"I found this game among Blaze Rhodon's suggested games.

The game is from the older generation of games - maybe a decade ago. However, Showdown Revenge showcases its enviable qualities, such as architecture, arrangement and gameplay.

The game appears to still be in demo. I don't know if there will be a finished version, but I think this is the best place to store it.

So it is likely that a new team will express a desire to create a finished version or an improved remake."

453216.overview: A crossover between two big franchises, Street Fighter and The King of Fighters.

453321.overview: Super Final Fight Gold Plus is the latest known version of the Final Fight Gold series by @Pierwolf, with authorized additions by @Don Drago. The game combines the best of Street Fighter and Final Fight with a gritty aesthetic and @Pierwolf's trademark level up system to create a unique blend of action and strategy.

453526.overview: If you enjoy Autism, you'll enjoy this too.

453542.overview:
And here's a long-awaited innovation from the world of Street of Rage. Shiva and others can use weapons - with brutal force and power. They treated me like a real destroyer. This game was created by the cohesive team of the openbor community and in particular the nickname Blaze Rhodon - an excellent artist with great ideas and the ability to create.
This is an excellent remake of the SoR series as a whole. New stories, a new character and additional bonus levels have been added.
The main characters are: Axel, Blaze, Shiva, Max, Yuri and Ralph from K.O.F.

454295.overview: Sailor Moon Plus is the first game in Destiny Revival series using the Beats of Rage game engine. The Super Nintendo games are recreated and improved to include new characters, new powers, more levels, in addition to original cinematics and all-new voice talent.

454383.overview: Sailor Moon R Extra is the second game in the Destiny Revival series using the Beats of Rage game engine. Taking the best of the original Super Famicom game and incorporating new characters never seen in a SMR game before, Sailor Moon R re-envisions and redirects the original game series back to its anime and manga origins.

456954.overview:
The game starts with 19 characters from Marvel's urban universe, in addition to the Fantastic Four and Captain America.
Another 12 characters are unlocked after the game is finished, including Spider-Man villains, Carnage himself and even Stan Lee.

Maximum Carnage for SNES and Sega Genesis is possibly the most faithful game to the comics. For those who don't know, one of Shirek's powers is Dark Empathy: She can bring out people's Dark Side. During the Maximum Carnage comics, she used this power to make the city go crazy, which is why in the game you face ordinary people on the streets. Which is good on one hand, but a bit annoying, because in the original game you face Carnage several times before the final battle, just like Shirek, so in this remake several changes were made, such as street enemies from Venom/Spider-Man: Separation Anxiety, Shield Agents instead of police officers, and in one of the battles you face in the original game once again all the bosses from the game in addition to civilians.

Another change is the cutting of cutscenes, because some didn't make sense, like Venom joining the team and Captain America as a sidekick, even though here they are available from the beginning of the game.

466206.overview:
Super Fightin' Spirit created in OpenBoR by bWWd, features characters from the Amiga game "Fightin' Spirit" and "Double Dragon" by NEOGEO they create this work of art with 12 playable characters: Kento, Rhajang, Lee Tong, Yuri, Lorentz, Burke, Ken, Amon, Duke, Fu Cheng, Rebecca, Billy Lee (Jimmy and changing palettes, so basically 13 if you count Jimmy /Billy Lee). The game contains a story mode, story mode with CPU, VS. Mode, Combo Arena mode for juggling and combos, and exhibition.

Super Fightin' Spirit creada en OpenBoR por bWWd, cuenta con personajes del juego de Amiga "Fightin' Spirit" y de "Double Dragon" de NEOGEO crean esta obra de arte con 12 personajes jugables: Kento, Rhajang, Lee Tong, Yuri, Lorentz, Burke, Ken, Amon, Duke, Fu Cheng, Rebecca, Billy Lee (Jimmy y al cambiar de paleta, por lo que, básicamente, 13 si se cuentan Jimmy / Billy Lee). Contiene el juego un modo historia, modo historia con CPU, Modo VS., Combo modo Arena de practicar malabares y combos, y exhibición.

v8.0 Rev. 2019.11.29 (DreamCast Version)

- Desbloqueado todos los niveles de los modos
+ Added shock meter
- Añadido medidor de golpes
+ Some concepts from the original game were removed and replaced and added by mine
- Algunos conseptos del juego original fueron eliminados y remplazado e añadido por los mios
+ Compiled in the new DreamBOR engine (OpenBOR v3.0 Build 4111 [4432]) Beta 6.2b
- Compilada en el nuevo motor del DreamBOR (OpenBOR v3.0 Build 4111 [4432]) Beta 6.2b

472974.overview:
We present Splatterhouse Duology – the newest, most ambitious and darkest OpenBoR creation by Nando. This special package combines two parts of his fan‑made Splatterhouse series, brought together for the first time in a single release.The duology includes:

Splatterhouse: O Portal – the first entry in the fan series, released about a year ago, laying the foundation for a new interpretation of the universe.
Splatterhouse: Dark Dimension – a completely new game, available for players for the first time.
The project is designed as a complete fan saga, allowing you to follow the story from beginning to end without searching for separate files or versions.

478889.overview:
Streets of Rage: Troubles in Japan is a full game that continues the fight after the SoR 3.

Mr. X’s organization may have been defeated, but its influence has survived in Japan. A new alliance of street gangs, mercenaries and yakuza is growing under the shadow of the old Syndicate. The heroes must travel across Japan, uncover the conspiracy and destroy it before Mr. X’s criminal empire can rise again.

* A new story campaign set in Japan
* 7 stages with new locations
* New enemies from SoR 4 and some reskined old ones.
* Some unique bosses
* Full badass soundtrack with 23 new compositions
